title: About the Center
text:
Our mission
To facilitate applied research and the expansion of evidence-based knowledge regarding crime and best practices in response to crime in the region and throughout Texas, the Southwest, and the nation.

title: About the Center
text:
Our goals




Inform policy and practice
Collaborate with public agencies, NGOs, the legislature, other institutions of higher education, and the private sector to identify criminal justice policy and practice issues of broad interest, and inform those issues with existing and new knowledge.





Partner with agencies
Work alongside criminal justice agencies to help them identify and implement evidence-based practices that improve their outcomes.





Build new knowledge
Produce new knowledge about best practices that can benefit the field of criminal justice well beyond our partner agencies.





Raise our profile
Increase the visibility and renown of the criminal justice research enterprise at Texas State University’s School of Criminal Justice and Criminology.

title: About the Center
text:
Advisory Board
Our advisory board brings together leaders from law enforcement, local government, higher education, and the nonprofit sector to keep the center’s work grounded in the needs of Texas communities.
